markdown: Every family, 30 trials per condition, a fresh cua-engine per trial, idle: the first capture against the same engine's capture 400 ms later (same size, at most 0.1% of the pixels off by more than 32). The pinned build captured each condition twice, against that truth.

| lane | family | condition | engine judged unobscured / kept offscreen | first capture right | wait median ms | wait max ms | reasons | first damage median ms | cold request median ms | pinned against the truth |

Control lane cua:control: 0 of 90 first captures wrong, so it shows nothing and the run fails.
failed: a first capture was wrong or unjudged, or the pinned build's capture did not confirm a truth
